point_estimate_zero_event_policy.if_subgroup_observed_wins_zero: D is undefined and MUST be serialized as null; Rc=Ra=0; implementation verdict is INCONCLUSIVE.

temporal_replication.split_rule: sort distinct eligible race_date ascending; A = first 6 dates; B = next 6 dates

inference.nan_policy: invalid/nonfinite subgroup variables excluded from subgroup only; bootstrap replicate invalid if observed wins=0 or required R/D nonfinite
inference.seed_A_derivation: first 64 bits of SHA256(prereg_id + ':A') unsigned big-endian
inference.seed_B_derivation: first 64 bits of SHA256(prereg_id + ':B') unsigned big-endian
inference.within_implementation_pairing: CONTROL and ABLATION use identical resampled race sets within each replicate
inference.zero_division_policy: No continuity correction; invalid bootstrap replicates discarded; if valid fraction <0.999 or valid reps <19980/20000 => INCONCLUSIVE
inference.ci_definition: Two-sided percentile 95% CI of D using numpy quantile method='linear' over valid paired race-cluster bootstrap replicates.

verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Data sufficiency or defined non-protocol data limitation prevents a valid statistical conclusion
verdict_rules.NOT_SUPPORTED: Protocol completes validly but any preregistered statistical support condition fails
verdict_rules.PROTOCOL_INVALID: Procedure, execution, locking, reconciliation, or one-shot integrity failure
SUPPORTED: blind feasibility minimums pass before outcomes

expected_preoutcome_manifest_requirement.purpose: Prevent A and B from passing merely by sharing the same wrong identity/subgroup/input hash implementation.

population.dead_heat_policy: y=1 for every actual starter with target_finish==1
